notes.title: Patch 3
notes.notes:
-Added a few new level events that happen
-Added new dialogue on first level and third level
-First level at computer panel there is now a new test outfit(I really like it)
-fixed couple other Cutscenes, this game had alot 
-Fixed AI not attacking on two parts one in second level and third
-As a request took some of the shotgun enemies out , just a few out of swarms since it made them to difficult
-Shotgun enemies now can die in a single head shot, Since they were too difficult as an request
-Changed health on some harder levels to give more of a fighting chance
-Added hints on some harder puzzled area's
-Added more lighting on Warehouse level since it's a dark level with darker armored enemies

Goal, I want to add where the enemies in each level spawn more different and random enemy type characters. It will make each playthrough more random feeling like a brand new experience each time you play. I also want to implement more props onto the main character. Such as glasses, Visor's, earrings, Necklaces, and so forth. These would be in the change clothes section on the pause menu. Usually a game will only let you pick one, I will have it where you can wear as many all together or whatever you want to do!
